title: Exploring the interactions of antihistamine with retinoic acid receptor beta (RARB) by molecular dynamics simulations and genome-wide meta-analysis.
authors: Kim, Minjae J; Kulkarni, Vishnutheertha; Goode, Micah A; Sivesind, Torunn E
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学模拟和虚拟筛选研究抗组胺药与维甲酸受体β的相互作用，但对象是蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法虽含MD但缺乏TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Kaposi sarcoma (KS) is one of the most common AIDS-related malignant neoplasms, which can leave lesions on the skin among HIV patients. These lesions can be treated with 9-cis-retinoic acid (9-cis-RA), an endogenous ligand of retinoic acid receptors that has been FDA-approved for treatment of KS. However, topical application of 9-cis-RA can induce several unpleasant side effects, like headache, hyperlipidemia, and nausea. Hence, alternative therapeutics with less side effects are desirable. There are case reports associating over-the-counter antihistamine usage with regression of KS. Antihistamines competitively bind to H1 receptor and block the action of histamine, best known for being released in response to allergens. Furthermore, there are already dozens of antihistamines that are FDA-approved with less side effects than 9-cis-RA. This led our team to conduct a series of in-silico assays to determine whether antihistamines can activate retinoic acid receptors. First, we utilized high-throughput virtual screening and molecular dynamics simulations to model high-affinity interactions between antihistamines and retinoic acid receptor beta (RARbeta). We then performed systems genetics analysis to identify a genetic association between H1 receptor itself and molecular pathways involved in KS. Together, these findings advocate for exploration of antihistamines against KS, starting with our two promising hit compounds, bepotastine and hydroxyzine, for experimental validation study in the future.
abstract_zh: 卡波西肉瘤（Kaposi sarcoma, KS）是艾滋病相关最常见的恶性肿瘤之一，可在HIV患者皮肤上留下病变。这些病变可用9-顺式维甲酸（9-cis-retinoic acid, 9-cis-RA）治疗，该药物是维甲酸受体的内源性配体，已获FDA批准用于KS治疗。然而，局部应用9-cis-RA可能引起若干不适副作用，如头痛、高脂血症和恶心。因此，需要副作用更小的替代疗法。有病例报告将非处方抗组胺药的使用与KS消退相关联。抗组胺药竞争性结合H1受体并阻断组胺的作用，组胺以响应过敏原释放而闻名。此外，已有数十种抗组胺药获FDA批准，其副作用小于9-cis-RA。这促使我们的团队进行一系列计算机模拟实验，以确定抗组胺药是否能激活维甲酸受体。首先，我们利用高通量虚拟筛选和分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟来建模抗组胺药与维甲酸受体β（RARbeta）之间的高亲和力相互作用。随后，我们进行了系统遗传学分析，以识别H1受体本身与KS相关分子通路之间的遗传关联。综合这些发现，我们主张探索抗组胺药对抗KS，从我们两个有前景的候选化合物——贝托斯汀（bepotastine）和羟嗪（hydroxyzine）开始，用于未来的实验验证研究。
